name: Vigilance (DC-17 hand blaster)
description: The Vigilance was a custom DC-17 hand blaster manufactured by Theed Arms and later awarded to Clone Captain CT-7567, nicknamed "Rex," during the Clone Wars, for his part in preventing the release of the Blue Shadow Virus on Naboo. The Vigilance—like its counterpart, the Negotiator—was specially plated with chromium.
